say:2:1720429001:0.text: Who is it now?! Can't you see I'm busy?

say:3:1720429002:1.text: ... Oh. Miss, judging by your attire... are you perhaps...
say:3:1720429002:1.source_cn: ……哎，这位小姐，看您的着装，莫非您是……

say:4:1720429003:0.text: Baron Grandet. I am Cassadee, a court mage. And this is Magister Merlin.
say:4:1720429003:0.source_cn: 葛朗台男爵，我是宫廷魔法师科丝蒂，和我在一起的这位是大...
say:4:1720429003:0.male: Baron Grandet. I am Cassadee, a court mage. And this is Magister Merlin.
say:4:1720429003:0.female: Baron Grandet. I am Cassadee, a court mage. And this is Magister Merlin.

say:5:1720429004:1.text: Oh dear! My eyes must be failing me. I hadn't realized I was in the presence of such distinguished company.
say:5:1720429004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，瞧我这眼睛，刚才背着光，竟没认出是两位魔法师大人...

choice_prompt:6:1720429004.text: Oh dear! My eyes must be failing me. I hadn't realized I was in the presence of such distinguished company.
choice_prompt:6:1720429004.source_cn: 哎呀，瞧我这眼睛，刚才背着光，竟没认出是两位魔法师大人大驾光临！

say:7:1720429005:1.text: My mistake, my mistake. Please forgive me.
say:7:1720429005:1.source_cn: 我的错我的错，实在是失敬，失敬！

say:8:1720429006:1.text: So this is the fabled Magister Merlin? I've heard so much about you. Now that I've met you in person, I can see the stories were true!
say:8:1720429006:1.source_cn: 这位就是传说中的大魔法师梅林阁下？久仰大名，今日一见，...
say:8:1720429006:1.male: So this is the fabled Magister Merlin? I've heard so much about you. Now that I've met you in person, I can see the stories were true!
say:8:1720429006:1.female: So this is the fabled Magister Merlin? I've heard so much about you. Now that I've met you in person, I can see the stories were true!

say:9:1720429007:0.text: Baron, we caught the two little troublemakers from the plaza. Are they yours?
say:9:1720429007:0.source_cn: 男爵，我们抓到了这两只在广场上作乱的小家伙。它们是你遗...

say:13:1720429009:0.text: Squawk! Cage! Hate it! Hate it!

say:15:1720429010:1.text: Let me see... yes, that's them. Those two little monsters are mine!
say:15:1720429010:1.source_cn: ……我看看，没错，没错！就是这两个小祖宗！

say:16:1720429011:1.text: I'm sure they've caused you both a lot of trouble. Don't worry. Once I get them home, I'll make sure they learn their lesson!
say:16:1720429011:1.source_cn: 这两个小淘气，一定打扰您二位清净了吧，回去之后我一定好...

say:17:1720429012:1.text: By the way... while you were tracking them down, you only saw the one monkey, yes? There weren't any other... partners, were there?
say:17:1720429012:1.source_cn: 说起来……二位大人在抓捕的过程中，就只看到这一只猴子吗...

choice_prompt:18:1720429012.text: By the way... while you were tracking them down, you only saw the one monkey, yes? There weren't any other... partners, were there?
choice_prompt:18:1720429012.source_cn: 说起来……二位大人在抓捕的过程中，就只看到这一只猴子吗？没有别的……同伙？

say:19:1720429013:0.text: Right, yes, of course, the bird. Silly me! I only meant... well, just in case they had somewhere else to hide. Wouldn't want more trouble in town!
say:19:1720429013:0.source_cn: 对对对！瞧我这脑子，又糊涂了！我就是随口一问，怕它们还...
say:19:1720429013:0.male: Right, yes, of course, the bird. Silly me! I only meant... well, just in case they had somewhere else to hide. Wouldn't want more trouble in town!
say:19:1720429013:0.female: Right, yes, of course, the bird. Silly me! I only meant... well, just in case they had somewhere else to hide. Wouldn't want more trouble in town!

say:20:1720429015:1.text: Natho, bring the gifts I prepared. We must thank our honored guests properly.
say:20:1720429015:1.source_cn: 纳班，快把我准备好的谢礼拿来，好好感谢两位大人！

say:24:1720429017:1.text: Please, accept this small token of my thanks.
say:24:1720429017:1.source_cn: 两位大人，这是我的一点心意。

say:25:1720429018:1.text: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...
say:25:1720429018:1.source_cn: 不知两位大人等会还有没有安排？如果没有的话，请务必让在...
say:25:1720429018:1.male: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...
say:25:1720429018:1.female: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...

choice_prompt:26:1720429018.text: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...
choice_prompt:26:1720429018.source_cn: 不知两位大人等会还有没有安排？如果没有的话，请务必让在下做东款待，感谢两位大人的无私帮助……
choice_prompt:26:1720429018.male: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...
choice_prompt:26:1720429018.female: And if you aren't otherwise engaged, I would be delighted to host you myself. It's the least I can do after all the trouble you went to on my behalf...

say:27:1720429019:1.text: Ah! Of course, of course. Royal matters come first. I spoke out of turn!
say:27:1720429019:1.source_cn: 原来如此！原来如此！那当然是正事要紧，正事要紧！是在下...

say:28:1720429020:1.text: Then I won't keep you another moment. Safe travels to you both!
say:28:1720429020:1.source_cn: 那么，我就不耽误两位大人的宝贵时间了。两位慢走，慢走！

choice:26:0:1.text: We already have somewhere to be.
choice:26:0:1.male: We already have somewhere to be.
choice:26:0:1.female: We already have somewhere to be.

choice:26:1:2.text: We've been invited to attend the royal ceremony.
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 我受王室邀请，前去观礼
choice:26:1:2.male: We've been invited to attend the royal ceremony.
choice:26:1:2.female: We've been invited to attend the royal ceremony.

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 那只鹦鹉不就是同伙吗？

say:30:1720429014:1.text: No, no, nothing of the sort. Forget I said anything! I was only asking in case they had some other hiding place and might end up causing more trouble in town!
say:30:1720429014:1.source_cn: 没有没有！绝对没有！您当我胡说八道！我就是随口一问，怕...

choice:6:0:1.text: Yeah, you need to get your eyes checked.
choice:6:0:1.male: Yeah, you need to get your eyes checked.
choice:6:0:1.female: Yeah, you need to get your eyes checked.
